title: LIBOR Discontinuation and the Cost of Bank Loans
authors: Jeong‐Bon Kim; Chong Wang; Feng Wu
eligible_reason: Single common treatment date, not staggered. did = Treatment x Post, where Treatment = bank's pre-announcement LIBOR-loan ratio above the sample median (time-invariant) and Post = loans issued from July 2017 (FCA announcement of LIBOR discontinuation) for every bank; loan-level reghdfe with bank and borrower FE and year dummies plus time-varying loan, borrower, bank and macro controls. Table 4 adds a parallel-trend test, pseudo-post falsification and a PSM sample; all share the same date. Package ships mock data only.
design_notes: Loan-level DealScan sample 2015-2019 (819 loans), absorb(bankid gvkey1) + i.year, clustered by bank and borrower. Common onset July 2017.
data_files_note: README: variables in the final data files have been replaced with randomly generated numbers because the data are licensed (DealScan, Compustat); actual results only in allresults_log.txt.
data_provenance_note: Mock datasets with randomly generated values.
screener_notes: Published text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2022.03133.txt). Ineligible on design (common date) and on data (mock).
